description: List the values a company reported in XBRL under any concept, not only the canonical statement metrics, exactly as each filing reported them, with unit, period and reporting filing. Undimensioned values of the standard taxonomies (paginated).

as_of.description: Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD); only values filed by then are returned.

concepts.description: Optional concepts to keep, qualified (us-gaap:Revenues) or bare (Revenues, any taxonomy).

filing_types.description: Optional forms of the reporting filing, e.g. 10-K.

units.description: Optional units to keep, e.g. USD or shares.

name: facts_as_reported
